definitions.explanation: Describes doing something quietly and secretly so as not to be noticed by others. Often implies a deliberate attempt to avoid detection.

examples.japanese: こっそり⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I slipped out of the room quietly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧こっそり⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: He was reading the letter secretly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}つからないように→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧こっそり⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate snacks on the sly so my parents wouldn't find out.

notes:
こっそり describes doing something secretly or stealthily, deliberately trying not to be noticed. The tone is relatively mild — it can describe innocent secrecy, not just wrongdoing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- こっそり〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something secretly
- こっそり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: variant with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ particle (slightly more literary)
- こっそり⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧: to sneak out
- こっそり⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat on the sly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦こそこそ→こそこそ：05792_kosokoso⟧: sneakily (more negative, implies suspicious behavior)
- ⟦ひそかに→密かに：05727_hisokani⟧: secretly (literary, can mean "inwardly")
- ⟦{内緒|ないしょ}→内緒：03126_naisho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in secret, confidentially
- ⟦{密|ひそ}かに→密かに：05727_hisokani⟧: in secret (formal/written)

USAGE:
こっそり often appears in lighthearted contexts: こっそり⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (sneaking a snack). ⟦こそこそ→こそこそ：05792_kosokoso⟧ sounds more suspicious and negative.
